## About

[AnVIL](https://anvilproject.org/) is NHGRI's Genomic Data Science Analysis, Visualization, and Informatics Lab-Space. 

This site hosts all things AnVIL Training! 
 
## Get Started

- Get started on AnVIL with our AnVIL 101 virtual workshop (check back for details soon!)
- Find help through our [community support forum](https://help.anvilproject.org/)
- Ask questions live at our monthly [virtual AnVIL Demos](https://help.anvilproject.org/c/demos/5)
- Check out our [upcoming events](https://anvilproject.org/events) for additional training opportunities, or browse our [docs](https://anvilproject.org/learn), [tutorials](tutorials.qmd) and [videos](videos.qmd) to start learning on your own

## Support for Groups

- Join our [AnVIL Champions](https://anvilproject.org/anvil-champions) program, where we train community members to become local AnVIL experts
